title: Understanding is the new bottleneck
summary: Geoffrey Litt argues that as AI makes code generation increasingly easy, the real bottleneck in software development has shifted from writing code to understanding, validating, and maintaining AI-generated code. The article explores how developer workflows, tools, and skills need to evolve to handle this new reality where 'understanding' becomes the critical scarce resource.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge that as AI makes code generation easier, the bottleneck has shifted to understanding and verifying AI-generated code rather than writing it.
why_valuable: Provides a forward-thinking perspective on how the role of software developers is fundamentally changing in the AI era, highlighting which skills become more valuable.
